theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_sl_im_partial_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → (∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y i)) → ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), Y i ω) ∧ ∀ G : Set (Euclid P), Z.massOn G ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Y i).massOn G
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
